36:55.text: Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things.

36:56.text: They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.

36:57.text: and all that they ask for.

36:59.text: (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islâmic Monotheism, wicked evil ones)

36:60.text: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitân
. Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.

36:61.text: And that you should worship Me
[Alone - Islâmic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]

36:62.text: did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?

36:63.text: This is Hell which you were promised!

36:64.text: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.

36:65.text: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn.
(It is said that one’s left thigh will be the first to bear the witness)

36:66.text: And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out
their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?

36:67.text: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them
in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward
nor they could have turned back.

36:68.text: And he whom We grant long life - We reverse him in creation

36:69.text: And We have not taught him
poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur’ân.

36:70.text: (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم or the Qur’ân)
may give warning to him who is living
may be justified against the disbelievers
